title: Repo Operation Events Starting and Ended
description: Introduce starting and ended events for all semio repo operations in the hook system. When a semio-repo MCP tool or CLI command is invoked, emit specific repo operation events (e.g. repo.ticket.open.starting, repo.ticket.open.ended) derived from agent.tool.starting/ended (MCP) or agent.tool.terminal.starting/ended (CLI). Add these as derived log entries in logHook alongside the generic agent.tool events.
